size.$description: Theme fachwerk (direction B): comfortable density, a sawn 2px edge, Bricolage Grotesque and IBM Plex Mono. Colours per mode in tokens.dark.json and tokens.light.json.

radius.$description: A sawn 2px edge, never rounder (fachwerk --radius: 2px). pill stays round for the identity shapes (avatar); controls are square through control.*.

display.$description: Weight and tracking do the hierarchy; width stays 100%

width.$description: Beams, not borders: every line is 2px of oak

elevation.$description: No shadows: depth comes from the deeper plaster and the beams. Nothing floats.

control.$description: Squares, never circles: checkbox, radio, switch and slider are framed squares with the sawn edge.

bar.$description: A progress track is a framed cell

motif.$description: The brace (Strebe) is the one ornament, drawn with gradients in the beam colour (line.subtle, fachwerk --line), never an image. The motif follows the mode, since it reads the variable where it is drawn.

hatch.$value: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, transparent 0 5px, color-mix(in oklch, var(--hn-line-subtle) 22%, transparent) 5px 7px)
hatch.$description: fw-hatch: the unfilled share of a bar, an empty seat, a placeholder

brace.$value: linear-gradient(45deg, transparent calc(50% - 1px), var(--hn-line-subtle) calc(50% - 1px), var(--hn-line-subtle) calc(50% + 1px), transparent calc(50% + 1px))
brace.$description: fw-brace: one 45deg beam across a square cell, bottom-left to top-right

cross.$value: linear-gradient(45deg, transparent calc(50% - 1px), var(--hn-line-subtle) calc(50% - 1px), var(--hn-line-subtle) calc(50% + 1px), transparent calc(50% + 1px)), linear-gradient(-45deg, transparent calc(50% - 1px), var(--hn-line-subtle) calc(50% - 1px), var(--hn-line-subtle) calc(50% + 1px), transparent calc(50% + 1px))
cross.$description: fw-x: the Andreaskreuz of a Brüstungsfeld

shell.$description: Flush: nothing floats. The rail, header and main are cells of one frame that share their 2px beams (fachwerk AppShell: 232px rail, 48px rows, a 64px brand cell, a beam under each).
